I have farmed these 3 mu for 50 years, just me alone since my husband passed ten years ago. I finished junior high, so I can read the fertilizer bags and understand what the seed dealer tells me, but I still trust my own eyes more than any book. Last year I grew cotton on all 3 mu and got about 260 kg per mu of seed cotton. The price was 7.2 yuan per kg, so after costs I had enough to live on and a little to put aside. This year I am sticking with cotton — I am 75, my knees hurt, and cotton is easier for one old woman to manage than wrestling with corn harvest.

For seeds, I will buy the improved Bt cotton seeds from the dealer in town. I do not remember the exact variety name, but it is the same kind my neighbor Zhang used last year and his bollworms were much better than mine. I need 1.5 kg of seed for my 3 mu, and it costs me 50 yuan per kg. I plant in late April when the soil warms up.

For fertilizer, I do exactly what worked last year, with one small change. I spread one 50-kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base fertilizer before planting — that is the 15-15-15 kind, so that gives 7.5 kg nitrogen, 7.5 kg phosphorus, and 7.5 kg potassium per mu. Then when the cotton flowers in mid-July, I top-dress with 15 kg of urea per mu. Two weeks later, when the bolls are setting, I put another 10 kg of urea per mu. The urea is 46% nitrogen, so that adds about 11.5 kg of nitrogen. In total I use about 19 kg nitrogen per mu, 7.5 kg phosphorus, and 7.5 kg potassium. I know that is a bit more nitrogen than some people say, but last year I tried cutting back and my yield dropped by 30 kg per mu. I would rather waste 20 yuan on extra fertilizer than lose 200 yuan in cotton.

Irrigation costs me diesel for the pump — 15 yuan each time I run the well for these 3 mu. I irrigate exactly three times: once right after sowing if the spring is dry, once at flowering in early July, and once in early August when the bolls need filling. Three times is enough. My neighbor Wang does four, but he has a son to help and more money.

For pesticides, I spray four times. The Bt seed handles the bollworms well, but I still get aphids and spider mites every July. I buy my spray from the same shop as last year. Two sprays I do myself with my backpack sprayer along the edges where the machine cannot reach well, and twice I hire the drone spray service from the village — 10 yuan per mu per spray. 

For tillage, I hire Old Li from the east end of the village to bring his rotary tiller. He charges 40 yuan per mu. I stopped using plough years ago — too hard on my back, and the rotary machine does a fine job for cotton.

I expect about 280 kg per mu of seed cotton this year. I am pushing a little harder on fertilizer because the futures price I heard at the grain station is up, and I need the money for medicine this winter. My total cash cost for the 3 mu will be about 1,400 yuan, which is what I have saved from selling eggs.
